subject.title: fix(qa): require persisted results in runtime parity

question: Should the QA owner accept the parent-linked fixture-session selection rule as the canonical release-parity contract after the remaining exact-head checks complete?
rationale: The patch changes how release QA determines whether Codex and OpenClaw runtime evidence belongs to a fixture; automated checks support the implementation, but the intended boundary for parent-linked child sessions is an owner-level validation contract.

options.title: Accept the bounded selector
options.body: Merge after the remaining exact-head checks pass, retaining only explicitly fixture-owned linked child sessions and excluding heartbeat or unrelated sessions.

options.title: Narrow the ownership rule further
options.body: Request an additional explicit fixture ownership marker if QA owners do not want parent linkage to be sufficient for retention.

options.title: Pause for contract clarification
options.body: Hold the PR if the canonical release-QA definition of a fixture-owned child session is still undecided.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded selector
recommendation.body: Merge after the remaining exact-head checks pass, retaining only explicitly fixture-owned linked child sessions and excluding heartbeat or unrelated sessions.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged runtime-parity predecessors that define the persistence and multi-session collection behavior this follow-up refines.
